Flying the ALL NEW Flywing Airwolf RC Helicopter! This helicopter has built in GPS and gyro making flight incredibly smooth and precise. If that’s not enough, it also has a coordinated turn mode that allows you to steer with the rudder and will auto bank the helicopter to make buttery smooth corners. 3 different speed controls, soft, normal, and sport so you can get this thing whippin. Flywing claims 23 minutes of flight time, but I was ending around 15 minutes (I like to end my batteries at storage charge) which I thought was solid. The retractable landing gear really set this apart from all other Helis though. It turns heads at the flying field! #radiocontrol #remotecontrol #rchelicopter #airwolf #rchobby

Flying the all new Freewing F-35C RC Jet! Hear that 110mm EDF ROAR! The biggest Jet that Freewing makes is a heavy, and large bird, but it’s graceful in the sky. This is a video of my second flight ever. Love the formation lights and afterburner. The sound is fantastic. Handles a bit more sensitive and temperamental than the F-22, but still a blast to fly. Landing gear handles the grass runway like it’s absolutely nothing. Even took my Navy landings pretty well.. haha. #radiocontrol #remotecontrol #f35 #fighterjet #rchobby
